source_message.text:
Here is the files and brief. Look forward to hear what you think.

We need an experienced Microsoft Word template specialist to review, fix, and improve a set of Word templates used in the latest Microsoft Word versions on Windows PC.

The work is not only visual. It must also be technically robust for real user behavior, especially copy-pasting from older legacy templates into the new templates.

**The appreciated help we want.**

1\. Read this brief carefully
2\. Review the newest template documents and support files
3\. Come back with:
• a fixed project price
• a proposed timeline
• any initial observations or risks

⸻

Scope of Work

1\. Test the current templates

User-test and function-test the current templates to make sure they are built correctly and behave reliably in normal day-to-day use.

This includes:
• styles
• list behavior
• indentation logic
• tab behavior
• line breaks
• tables
• columns
• copy-paste behavior
• overall formatting stability

⸻

2\. Implement new styles across all templates

Implement the new style system described in the document:

new\_styles\_for\_implementation\_pbu

This must be applied consistently across all templates.

⸻

3\. Suggest improvements

Review the templates and suggest:
• need-to-have improvements
• nice-to-have improvements

These can include missing features, structural improvements, usability enhancements, or technical fixes that would make the templates more stable and easier to use.

⸻

Environment

All templates will be used in the latest Microsoft Word versions on PC.

Please optimize for:
• modern Word for Windows
• real user editing behavior
• stable use across multiple users

⸻

Customer Design Feedback to Implement

A. Indentation logic and Tab functionality

Users must be able to use the Tab key naturally to create sub-levels in all relevant list styles.

Requirements:
• all list styles must support intuitive sub-level indentation
• hierarchy must remain clean and structured
• list levels must follow the vertical alignment logic shown in the brief
• nested levels must align consistently throughout the document

(See New\_styles\_for\_implementation\_pbu for design guides)

B. Graphic bullet design

Adjust bullet styling so that:
• bullet size is proportionate to the text size
• bullets are visually balanced
• bullets are vertically middle-aligned with the text
• bullets scale naturally with the font size

C. Rename all styles

If relevant for copy paste isuues, all styles in the templates must be renamed with the prefix:

PBU -

Examples:
• PBU - Heading 1
• PBU - Body Text
• PBU - Bullet List

This applies to all relevant styles:
• headings
• body text
• quotes
• list styles
• table-related styles
• other active styles used in the templates

⸻

Customer Error Feedback to Resolve

1\. Compatibility and copy-paste stability

Users are currently experiencing major formatting issues when moving content from older templates into the new templates.

For testing purposes, old templates are provided:
• Old\_v1.docx
• Old\_v2.docx

We need this workflow tested and stabilized as much as possible.

2\. Line break issues

Fix the issue where users cannot reliably create manual line breaks after pasted content.

3\. Table and column integrity

Fix the issue where:
• the right-hand column moves outside the page margins during paste
• table layouts break when content is pasted

The table structure must remain locked and stable within the page layout.

4\. Style break prevention

Review whether it is possible to reduce or prevent template styles from breaking when text is pasted from legacy documents.

We understand Word has limitations here, but we want the most robust setup possible.

⸻

Testing Requirements

Please perform thorough testing on:
• all list levels
• bullet lists
• numbered lists
• multilevel list behavior
• tab and indent behavior
• table behavior
• column behavior
• copy-paste from legacy templates
• manual line breaks after pasting
• overall layout stability

Specific test requirement

Please specifically test the copy-paste workflow from old PBU templates into V14 and verify that:
• layout remains stable
• styles behave predictably
• the Tab functionality works intuitively for end users
• list hierarchy remains aligned and usable

⸻

Deliverables

Please include in your proposal:
1\. Fixed project price
2\. Estimated timeline
3\. notes on recommended need-to-have and nice-to-have improvements

At delivery, we expect:
• updated template files
• consistent PBU style naming (maybe)
• implemented new styles (See New\_styles\_for\_implementation\_pbu for design guides)
• improved list behavior
• improved paste stability where technically possible

value_updates.hierarchy_behavior: clean, structured, and consistently aligned nested levels

source_message.text:
Salma Malik

Here are the first feedback from our customer. Let me know what you think.

Proposal \(Indstilling\):
• Placeholder fields: When clicking into the "insert" fields \(Advantages, settings, attachments, headline, and date\), the existing text is not automatically cleared, unlike the behavior in the Executive Summary.
• Text boxes: The text boxes on the left side, including the headline, do not use automatic word wrap when they run out of space. Instead, they push the right-hand column further to the right.
• Line breaks: This forces the user to use manual line breaks. Unfortunately, a "normal" line break \(hard return\) results in excessive line spacing. While the spacing fits well between bullet points, it is too wide for continuous text. A "soft return" \(Shift\+Enter\) works, but I doubt our colleagues know how to use that.
• Date function: Is it possible to implement the same date functionality as seen in the "Board Seminar" document?
Guidance \(Vejledning\):
• Margins: Under the "\(short description\)" section, the margins are not fixed. If you don't use manual line breaks, part of the "pencil" icon is gradually cut off. Is it possible to set fixed margins?
• Theme description: Same issue as mentioned in point 3 under "Proposal."
• Reflections: Under "\(write own reflections, if any\)," the same issue as point 1 under "Proposal."
Board Seminar \(Bestyrelsesseminar\):
• Multi-line support: It must be possible to write multiple lines under "Item and Title." Manual line breaks must be supported here.
• Agenda: Under "\(insert agenda\)," the same issue as point 1 under "Proposal."
Board Meeting \(Bestyrelsesmøde\):
• Date function: Is it possible to get the same date functionality as in the "Board Seminar" document?
• Alignment: "Item and Title" are not aligned with "Topic," "Proposal," and "Start time."
• Formatting issues: If I add an extra line immediately after a "Topic," an extra horizontal line/border is also added. If we add a line elsewhere, it works as intended.
Master:
• Review: We need to review this with Walid, as the bullet sizes and spacing still appear incorrect on my screen.
• Tables: I need an explanation/walkthrough of how the tables work.
• Color palette: We should not have all these colors available as options.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Here is the files and brief. Look forward to hear what you think.

We need an experienced Microsoft Word template specialist to review, fix, and improve a set of Word templates used in the latest Microsoft Word versions on Windows PC.

The work is not only visual. It must also be technically robust for real user behavior, especially copy-pasting from older legacy templates into the new templates.

**The appreciated help we want.**

1\. Read this brief carefully
2\. Review the newest template documents and support files
3\. Come back with:
• a fixed project price
• a proposed timeline
• any initial observations or risks

⸻

Scope of Work

1\. Test the current templates

User-test and function-test the current templates to make sure they are built correctly and behave reliably in normal day-to-day use.

This includes:
• styles
• list behavior
• indentation logic
• tab behavior
• line breaks
• tables
• columns
• copy-paste behavior
• overall formatting stability

⸻

2\. Implement new styles across all templates

Implement the new style system described in the document:

new\_styles\_for\_implementation\_pbu

This must be applied consistently across all templates.

⸻

3\. Suggest improvements

Review the templates and suggest:
• need-to-have improvements
• nice-to-have improvements

These can include missing features, structural improvements, usability enhancements, or technical fixes that would make the templates more stable and easier to use.

⸻

Environment

All templates will be used in the latest Microsoft Word versions on PC.

Please optimize for:
• modern Word for Windows
• real user editing behavior
• stable use across multiple users

⸻

Customer Design Feedback to Implement

A. Indentation logic and Tab functionality

Users must be able to use the Tab key naturally to create sub-levels in all relevant list styles.

Requirements:
• all list styles must support intuitive sub-level indentation
• hierarchy must remain clean and structured
• list levels must follow the vertical alignment logic shown in the brief
• nested levels must align consistently throughout the document

(See New\_styles\_for\_implementation\_pbu for design guides)

B. Graphic bullet design

Adjust bullet styling so that:
• bullet size is proportionate to the text size
• bullets are visually balanced
• bullets are vertically middle-aligned with the text
• bullets scale naturally with the font size

C. Rename all styles

If relevant for copy paste isuues, all styles in the templates must be renamed with the prefix:

PBU -

Examples:
• PBU - Heading 1
• PBU - Body Text
• PBU - Bullet List

This applies to all relevant styles:
• headings
• body text
• quotes
• list styles
• table-related styles
• other active styles used in the templates

⸻

Customer Error Feedback to Resolve

1\. Compatibility and copy-paste stability

Users are currently experiencing major formatting issues when moving content from older templates into the new templates.

For testing purposes, old templates are provided:
• Old\_v1.docx
• Old\_v2.docx

We need this workflow tested and stabilized as much as possible.

2\. Line break issues

Fix the issue where users cannot reliably create manual line breaks after pasted content.

3\. Table and column integrity

Fix the issue where:
• the right-hand column moves outside the page margins during paste
• table layouts break when content is pasted

The table structure must remain locked and stable within the page layout.

4\. Style break prevention

Review whether it is possible to reduce or prevent template styles from breaking when text is pasted from legacy documents.

We understand Word has limitations here, but we want the most robust setup possible.

⸻

Testing Requirements

Please perform thorough testing on:
• all list levels
• bullet lists
• numbered lists
• multilevel list behavior
• tab and indent behavior
• table behavior
• column behavior
• copy-paste from legacy templates
• manual line breaks after pasting
• overall layout stability

Specific test requirement

Please specifically test the copy-paste workflow from old PBU templates into V14 and verify that:
• layout remains stable
• styles behave predictably
• the Tab functionality works intuitively for end users
• list hierarchy remains aligned and usable

⸻

Deliverables

Please include in your proposal:
1\. Fixed project price
2\. Estimated timeline
3\. notes on recommended need-to-have and nice-to-have improvements

At delivery, we expect:
• updated template files
• consistent PBU style naming (maybe)
• implemented new styles (See New\_styles\_for\_implementation\_pbu for design guides)
• improved list behavior
• improved paste stability where technically possible

value_updates.pasted_column_containment: right-hand columns remain within page margins during paste
value_updates.pasted_table_layout_stability: table structure remains locked and stable within the page layout when content is pasted

Salma Malik

Here are the first feedback from our customer. Let me know what you think.

Proposal \(Indstilling\):
• Placeholder fields: When clicking into the "insert" fields \(Advantages, settings, attachments, headline, and date\), the existing text is not automatically cleared, unlike the behavior in the Executive Summary.
• Text boxes: The text boxes on the left side, including the headline, do not use automatic word wrap when they run out of space. Instead, they push the right-hand column further to the right.
• Line breaks: This forces the user to use manual line breaks. Unfortunately, a "normal" line break \(hard return\) results in excessive line spacing. While the spacing fits well between bullet points, it is too wide for continuous text. A "soft return" \(Shift\+Enter\) works, but I doubt our colleagues know how to use that.
• Date function: Is it possible to implement the same date functionality as seen in the "Board Seminar" document?
Guidance \(Vejledning\):
• Margins: Under the "\(short description\)" section, the margins are not fixed. If you don't use manual line breaks, part of the "pencil" icon is gradually cut off. Is it possible to set fixed margins?
• Theme description: Same issue as mentioned in point 3 under "Proposal."
• Reflections: Under "\(write own reflections, if any\)," the same issue as point 1 under "Proposal."
Board Seminar \(Bestyrelsesseminar\):
• Multi-line support: It must be possible to write multiple lines under "Item and Title." Manual line breaks must be supported here.
• Agenda: Under "\(insert agenda\)," the same issue as point 1 under "Proposal."
Board Meeting \(Bestyrelsesmøde\):
• Date function: Is it possible to get the same date functionality as in the "Board Seminar" document?
• Alignment: "Item and Title" are not aligned with "Topic," "Proposal," and "Start time."
• Formatting issues: If I add an extra line immediately after a "Topic," an extra horizontal line/border is also added. If we add a line elsewhere, it works as intended.
Master:
• Review: We need to review this with Walid, as the bullet sizes and spacing still appear incorrect on my screen.
• Tables: I need an explanation/walkthrough of how the tables work.
• Color palette: We should not have all these colors available as options.
